news.analysis: Jones has been downright abysmal this season, throwing just four touchdown passes to seven interceptions, with only one passing touchdown in the last four games. His rushing hasn't been there for him either, as he's only had one score on the ground and is averaging fewer than 10 rushing yards per game this season. Rumblings will build for the team to give Anthony Richardson or some other name a shot if things continue to spiral, Steichen is likely coaching for his job, and Jones is playing for his job at this point as well. He's the QB28 on the season, but the QB37 in PPG among QBs with multiple games under their belt. He's not startable in any league at this point.
news.contents: Daniel Jones is still the Colts starter, per HC Shane Steichen.
news.title: Daniel Jones backed by HC Steichen, still Colts starter

news.analysis: Cooks had another quiet week despite a season-high snap rate, appearing on 68% of the offensive plays. The 49ers are desperate for healthy wide receivers, but that doesn't mean they're going to make an impact. Quarterback Brock Purdy completed 27 passes - seven were caught by a wide receiver, a trend that could continue.
news.contents: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandin Cooks caught one pass for 13 yards for the second week in a row in a Week 7 loss to the Atlanta Falcons
